testimonies.testimony: I entered the trailer, oh, a little before noon.
The meeting began at 12:00 sharp. It ended at 4:00..
There was to be a rehearsal afterwards, so we went to Studio One.
I was fatigued, so I had Sal take me.
At 2:30, we took a 15-minute break in the meeting.
Sal and I ate t-bone steaks on the table in front of the trailer.

source.explanation: The plate containing the steak bones is found in the employee area, not in front of the trailer as the witness said.
source.context_span: This is where Sal Manella and Dee Vasquez ate. There's nothing left on the plates.

turns.summarizedContext: The filming site has many separate areas, including the employee area and the trailer. A plate with nothing on it was found on the table in front of the trailer. No food or dish was cleared out whatsoever on that. The witness Vasquez is testifying about her itinary on the day of the crime.
reasoning: Fact 1: The witness claims they ate t-bone steaks in front of the trailer.
Fact 2: The evidence suggests t-bone steaks were found in the employee area.
Fact 3: The context suggests there were no bones left where the witness ate.
